name: Pendle
description: Pendle splits yield-bearing assets (stETH, sUSDe, USDe, etc.) into PT (fixed yield, redeemable 1:1 for the accounting asset at maturity) and YT (all variable yield and points until maturity), traded in a PT/SY AMM. Agents can buy/sell PT and YT, add/remove liquidity, and mint/redeem through PendleRouter V4, ideally with calldata built by Pendle's Hosted SDK (Convert API); PENDLE can be staked into sPENDLE on Ethereum.

keyFunctions.description: Buy PT (fixed yield) with a token: (receiver, market, minPtOut, ApproxParams guessPtOut, TokenInput input, LimitOrderData limit). Returns (netPtOut, netSyFee, netSyInterm). Approve the router for tokenIn first. TokenInput = (tokenIn, netTokenIn, tokenMintSy, pendleSwap, swapData(swapType uint8, extRouter, extCalldata, needScale)). Without an aggregator: tokenIn = tokenMintSy = a token the SY accepts (SY.getTokensIn()), pendleSwap = 0x0, swapData = (0, 0x0, 0x, false). For native ETH use tokenIn = 0x0 and send msg.value. offchainApis.name: Pendle Hosted SDK - Convert API (v3, recommended)
offchainApis.use: POST JSON {receiver, slippage (0-1, 0.01 = 1%), inputs:[{token, amount}], outputs:[address], enableAggregator?, aggregators?, additionalData?}. One endpoint for every action: token->PT/YT (swap), PT/YT->token, token->LP (add liquidity), LP->token, token->[PT,YT] (mint), [PT,YT] or PT after expiry->token (redeem), token<->SY, LP->LP (transfer liquidity), PT->PT (roll over). Response: action, requiredApprovals [{token, amount}] (approve these to tx.to first), routes[] sorted by output; routes[0].tx = {to (PendleRouter V4), data (ready calldata), from, value}, routes[0].outputs, routes[0].contractParamInfo (method + decoded params, including ApproxParams and limit-order fills), routes[0].data.priceImpact. Tested 2026-11-25: USDe->PT-USDe on chain 1 returned swapExactTokenForPt calldata to 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946. Amounts in wei. Rate limit 200 computing units/minute and 200,000/week per IP; each aggregator adds CU.

actions.name: find a market
actions.description: Get the market, PT, YT and SY addresses for an asset and expiry.
actions.how: GET https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v2/markets/all?chainId=<id>&limit=100 (page with skip). Strip the '<chainId>-' prefix from pt/yt/sy. On-chain, market.readTokens() returns (SY, PT, YT), market.expiry() the unix maturity and market.isExpired() whether it has matured; MarketFactoryV6.isValidMarket(market) confirms a V6 market. Pick a market whose expiry has not passed.

actions.name: buy PT (lock a fixed yield) - recommended path
actions.description: Swap a token for PT via the Hosted SDK.
actions.how: POST https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v3/sdk/<chainId>/convert with {receiver, slippage: 0.005, inputs:[{token: tokenIn, amount: wei}], outputs:[PT]}; for any token not accepted by the SY add enableAggregator: true. Approve each requiredApprovals token to routes[0].tx.to (PendleRouter 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946), then send routes[0].tx (to, data, value). The PT matures to 1 accounting-asset unit; hold to expiry for the quoted fixed APY (data.impliedApy with additionalData).

actions.name: buy PT on-chain without the API
actions.how: Preview with RouterStatic.swapExactTokenForPtStatic(market, tokenIn, amount) -> netPtOut. Approve the router, then router.swapExactTokenForPt(receiver, market, minPtOut = netPtOut*(1-slippage), ApproxParams(0, 2^256-1, 0, 256, 1e14), TokenInput(tokenIn, amount, tokenIn, 0x0, (0, 0x0, 0x, false)), LimitOrderData(0x0, 0, [], [], 0x)). tokenIn must be in SY.getTokensIn().

actions.name: sell PT / YT before maturity
actions.description: Exit a PT or YT position to a token.
actions.how: Convert API with inputs [{token: PT or YT, amount}] and outputs [tokenOut]; or router.swapExactPtForToken / swapExactYtForToken(receiver, market, amountIn, TokenOutput(tokenOut, minOut, tokenOut, 0x0, (0, 0x0, 0x, false)), empty LimitOrderData) after approving the PT/YT to the router.

actions.name: redeem PT at maturity
actions.description: Turn matured PT into the underlying.
actions.how: After market.isExpired(): Convert API inputs [{token: PT, amount}] outputs [token]; or router.redeemPyToToken(receiver, YT, ptAmount, TokenOutput(...)) after approving PT. No protocol fee after maturity. Before maturity redemption needs equal PT and YT.

actions.name: buy YT (long yield / points)
actions.description: Leveraged exposure to the underlying APY and points until maturity.
actions.how: Convert API with outputs [YT], or router.swapExactTokenForYt(receiver, market, minYtOut, default ApproxParams, TokenInput, empty LimitOrderData). Claim yield with router.redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, [], [YT], []) or the YT's own redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, true, true).

actions.name: provide liquidity
actions.description: Zap one token into a Pendle pool (LP earns swap fees, PT fixed yield, underlying yield and PENDLE incentives).
actions.how: Convert API outputs [market address] (outputs [market, YT] for zero-price-impact 'keep YT' mode); or router.addLiquiditySingleToken(receiver, market, minLpOut, default ApproxParams, TokenInput, empty LimitOrderData). Exit with inputs [market] outputs [token] or router.removeLiquiditySingleToken. Claim PENDLE with router.redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, [], [], [market]).

actions.name: stake PENDLE (sPENDLE)
actions.how: PENDLE.approve(0x999999999991E178D52Cd95AFd4b00d066664144, amt); sPENDLE.stake(amt). Unstake: cooldown(amt), wait 14 days, finalizeCooldown(); or instantUnstake(amt) with a 5% fee.

risks: PT is a zero-coupon claim: it redeems 1:1 for the accounting asset (the asset in brackets, e.g. PT-ezETH (ETH) redeems 1 ETH worth of ezETH, not 1 ezETH) only at maturity. Selling before maturity is at market price, which moves with the implied APY: if implied APY rises after you buy, the PT price falls and you show a loss until maturity.

YT value decays toward 0 and is exactly 0 at maturity. You profit only if the yield (and points) collected exceeds the implied APY paid; if the underlying yield drops or points disappoint, YT can lose most or all of its value.

Every market has an expiry. After expiry you cannot buy PT/YT in it; unredeemed matured PT and LP keep accruing, but that yield and those points are redirected to the Pendle treasury, so redeem promptly.
PT/YT inherit all risks of the underlying yield-bearing asset and its SY wrapper (depeg, hack, slashing, issuer freezes). Newer SY contracts are upgradable proxies controlled by Pendle governance.
Swap fees scale with time to maturity (Fee Tier / 365 x days to maturity); large trades have price impact. Set minPtOut / minTokenOut / slippage; the Convert API's slippage parameter does this.
Pendle charges 5% of all YT yield (including points).
PendleRouter V4 is an upgradeable diamond (EIP-2535) controlled by Pendle; block explorers do not show its full ABI (use IPAllActionV3).
RouterStatic results are previews for off-chain use; Pendle says not to use it for fund-sensitive on-chain logic.
sPENDLE: 14-day cooldown to unstake fee-free, or 5% fee for instant unstake; rewards require meeting active-participation criteria.
notes: Markets (PT/YT/SY/LP) are created continuously and expire, so this file lists none: discover them with GET https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v2/markets/all or in the Pendle app (market page > contract addresses). Each market address is also its LP token. All core addresses come from the official deployments folder https://github.com/pendle-finance/pendle-core-v2-public/tree/main/deployments (files <chainId>-core.json, cited per contract), which the docs Deployments page points to. PendleRouter V4 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946 is the same on every chain listed; older routers V1 0x41FAD93F225b5C1C95f2445A5d7fcB85bA46713f, V2 0x0000000001e4ef00d069e71d6ba041b0a16f7ea0 and V3 0x00000000005BBB0EF59571E58418F9a4357b68A0 still work but should not be used. Market factory: V6 is the current one (late 2025); earlier markets were created by marketFactory/V3/V4/V5 (addresses in the same file). The limit-order router is 0x000000000000c9B3E2C3Ec88B1B4c0cD853f4321 on Ethereum (field limitRouter). vePENDLE 0x4f30A9D41B80ecC5B94306AB4364951AE3170210 is listed under 'deprecated' in 1-core.json and was replaced by sPENDLE, so it is not included. Chains: the docs Deployments page lists Ethereum, Optimism, BNB, Sonic, HyperEVM, Mantle, Base, Arbitrum, Berachain, Monad, Katana and Ink; Katana (747474) and Ink (57073) files contain no router/market contracts (cross-chain PT infrastructure only), so they are left out. Plasma (9745), X Layer (196) and Robinhood Chain (4663) have full core files in the GitHub folder (and DefiLlama TVL) and are included. Unichain (130) and Tempo (4217) files have no RouterStatic/market factory and Avalanche (43114) has none of these, so they are left out. Market factories and RouterStatic are included only where listed above; for other chains the MarketFactoryV6 address is in that chain's file (key marketFactoryV6). For secondary chains PENDLE is the bridged token deployed by Pendle. Boros (Pendle's funding-rate trading venue on Arbitrum) is a separate product and not covered here. Bytecode was confirmed on every listed address via eth_getCode on 2026-11-25; router selectors were checked against the Ethereum facet bytecode.
